stem: What is a theme that is present in BOTH the story "Last Dance" and the poem "The Tree"?
instruction: Use Last Dance and The Tree to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Have the courage to live life to its fullest.

options.label: G
options.text: Always be prepared to confide in loved ones.

options.label: H
options.text: Have patience when striving to reach a goal.

options.label: J
options.text: Never take for granted the small wonders of daily life.
